name: Ha Long squid cake
summary: Chả mực Hạ Long is the squid cake on the cruise boats, at provincial banquets, and on the Tết table. Eat it hot, with rice sheets, plain sticky rice, or rice.
origin: Hạ Long, Quảng Ninh. The tourism pages treat it as a Quảng Ninh dish and a Hạ Long specialty.
culture: The tourism pages call it one of 50 specialties recognized by Trung tâm Sách kỷ lục Việt Nam. It is served on the cruise boats and at provincial banquets.

The Tết article calls it a dish of Quảng Ninh cooking and a gift. In 2024, over the 30 April–1 May holiday at Công viên Đại Dương in phường Bãi Cháy, visitors were served chả mực and beer free and looked at a record squid cake. That free service is the 2024 festival. Do not extend it to another year.
howToEat: Eat it hot, with bánh cuốn, xôi trắng, or cơm.
A breakfast clock was not printed. On the boat, or at Tết on the family table, is when the pages place it. Check on arrival.
where: On the cruise boats, and at the Hạ Long table. Not a named stall. Xôi chả mực is the rice and the cake together, on the same provincial list.
priceBand: A stall price was not printed.
